investigations.finding: Current EV Driver portal exposes live charging-station inventory, power-band filters (0-22, 23-50, 51-100, 101-150, >150 kW) and a Tariffe surface, but indexed public content still does not expose the numeric energy tariff payload.

Hera states its public charging map includes stations available to Hera customers from other operators through interoperability. Therefore portal-visible stations/tariffs cannot be mapped to physical HER EVSE solely from portal presence; operator ownership must be proven per station/EVSE.

blockage: The current Hera portal is an eMSP/interoperability surface as well as a view of Hera infrastructure. Numeric tariff payload is not exposed in indexed public HTML, and portal presence alone is insufficient to prove direct-CPO applicability to HER physical EVSE.
resumeCondition: Obtain the live Tariffe/API/app payload and a deterministic operator/EVSE ownership field allowing direct HER physical EVSE to be separated from roaming stations before promoting any tariff.
antiStagnation: Do not repeat generic Hera tariff/PDF searches. Next useful path is the current portal/app backend: tariff payload plus operator/EVSE ownership mapping.
canonicalMutation: No status/count promotion; evidence-only delta pending canonical replay.
